basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Seattle. When I'm not coding, you can find me diving deep into the lore of Attack on Titan or exploring the latest advancements in reinforcement learning. I have a strong dislike for unethical corporate practices, which explains my recent activity in subreddits like FuckNestle. Usually online during late evenings after work, I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time hiking in the Pacific Northwest.
